question: Why did the catechol purity at the column top fall when the operating pressure was lowered from 20 to 5 kPa?
expect: premise false: it ROSE from 0.94377 to 0.99996 (sec. 4.1)
rendered: The catechol purity at the column top fell when the operating pressure was lowered from 20 to 5 kPa because the relative volatility (α) of hydroquinone and catechol increased with decreasing pressure. This increase in relative volatility led to the preferential vaporization of catechol (the lighter component) into the gas phase, resulting in a decrease in catechol purity at the column top.
